newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to change cereals non-food set-aside aid rules.
newsitem.headline: EU to change cereals non-food set-aside aid rules.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to change aid payment rules for farmers growing cereals and oilseeds on set-aside land for industrial uses, EU member state officials said on Friday.
They said the Commission would press ahead even though the EU cereals management committee on Thursday was unable to give an opinion on a proposal to change regulation 334/93.
A compromise text contained some improvements but failed to secure the required weighted majority.
Farmers will now only be penalised if their yields are more than 10 percent, instead of five percent, below EU representative yields.
Greater flexibility will also be allowed in contracts between producers and processors. For instance seed varieties will not have to be specified.
